factualDispositions.0600: Again refers to Match5, where Padeira as Pistoleiro was also killed Night1.
factualDispositions.1440: Full spoken sentence says Vidente Espiritual; thirty-second review boundaries split a continuing sentence.
factualDispositions.1350: Dead wolves remain in the grid with skull icons. A red wolf-team border is not a claim that the player is alive.
factualDispositions.1740: Previous-game Relojoeiro was Prefeito; Match6 he was Vidente and was lynched Day2 after wrong old-role demands. This line refers to Match6, not Moleiro in Match7. Florista arithmetic joke is not a claim of actual kills.

factualDispositions.0210: Jail is a night-only ability. Prisoners leave at dawn; a living player without bars during day is correct.
factualDispositions.0660: Actual15 voting entries have six votes each for Costureira and Lenhador, and three abstentions. No lynch; the review miscounted.
factualDispositions.1170: Ceramista was attacked on Nights3,4,6; saved medically on3/4. Full records confirm third attack on6.

factualDispositions.1680: Actual Night1 detective targets Ferreiro/Florista, different teams. Night3 comparison Florista/Pescador is additional, not a replacement.
factualDispositions.1950: Scoreboard narration summarizes three different matches. Cozinheira was lynched as Médica in Match5; holywater killed Ceramista and the bullet killed Alfa in Match7, expressed as separate successes.

visualDispositions.openingAt20Seconds: Exactly the boundary of a new opening card. Pink is the brief animated transition; source sequence resumes title after transition. Opening audio retained.
visualDispositions.typewriterAndChat: Floating speech types progressively; persistent chat retains full messages and intentionally scrolls older entries. Partial word in a sampled frame is not a cut audio line.
visualDispositions.lowVarietyWarnings: Two-frame review scores retained as given. Original persistent HUD, speaking avatar, mouth/eye motion, camera motion, clouds, transitions and timed memes are present between the still samples. No assertion that two stills prove 30 seconds of frozen video.
visualDispositions.stamps: Short drawn editorial stamps intentionally overlay the accused player; no invented AI statement or decision is substituted.
